description: Safely manages and toggles startup applications, environment settings, and desktop rice configurations (Hyprland, i3, Sway, Waybar, bashrc, zshrc).

parameters.name: app
parameters.description: Name of the application, daemon, or script to configure in rice/autostart

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: True to enable/uncomment in autostart, false to disable/comment out

optionalParameters.name: target
optionalParameters.description: Target configuration (hyprland, i3, sway, bashrc, zshrc, or file path)
